serverInfo.name: tnt-house-risk-data-api
serverInfo.description: RiskDataApi — Solana token risk for AI agents. 5 MCP calls/day free with no signup, then a free email key (15/day, via the get_free_api_key tool) or x402 pay-per-call ($0.02 USDC). Returns safety_score, first-funder insider clusters, honeypot risk, LP lock, mint/freeze authority in one call.

authentication.notes: Bearer token is optional. Without a key, check_token_risk is limited to 5 successful calls/day per caller identity (also capped at 20/day per IP, 60/day per /24 subnet, and 300/day globally). get_token_risk_history is free/unmetered and get_free_api_key works with no key (IP and global signup caps apply, one active key per email). Pass a key via the Authorization: Bearer header or the api_key argument; the header wins if both are present. Quota refusals return JSON with error_code, message, and options[] (ids free_key, x402, top_up). Free email key: 15 calls/day via get_free_api_key(email) or POST https://www.tnt-audit.com/api/v1/signup. Pay per call: x402 $0.02 USDC on Solana at GET https://www.tnt-audit.com/api/v1/token-risk/x402?mint=<mint>, no account. Batch (max 25 mints) needs a key or x402, all-or-nothing.

tools.name: check_token_risk
tools.description: Returns a 0-100 safety score, on-chain insider wallet clusters (wallets sharing a first funder), mint/freeze authority status, holder concentration, and live price/liquidity/volume for a single Solana token mint. Use before recommending or executing a trade on any Solana token. 5 free anonymous calls/day, no signup. Then call get_free_api_key (15/day) or pay per call via x402; pass a key via the Authorization header or the api_key argument. Quota refusals return error_code + options[] with the exact next step.

mint.description: The Solana token mint address to check

api_key.description: Optional. Your RiskDataApi key, for MCP hosts that cannot send an Authorization header. If both are present, the Authorization header wins.

tools.name: check_token_risk_batch
tools.description: Same as check_token_risk but for up to 25 mints in one call — N mints charged as N calls, same per-call economics as check_token_risk, no bulk discount. All-or-nothing: if the batch can't be fully covered by remaining quota/credit, the whole batch is rejected rather than partially processed. Needs an API key (Authorization header or api_key argument) or x402 — no anonymous batch calls.

api_key.description: Optional. Your RiskDataApi key, for MCP hosts that cannot send an Authorization header. If both are present, the Authorization header wins.

tools.name: get_free_api_key
tools.description: Issues a free RiskDataApi key for an email address (15 checks/day instead of 5 anonymous calls/day). No email verification. One active key per email; the key is returned once and also emailed. Use it when you hit the anonymous daily limit.

email.description: Email address to register the free key to

tools.name: create_topup_invoice
tools.description: Creates a Solana payment invoice for your API key: kind "topup" adds call credit ($5-$500, usd_amount, default $5); kind "subscription" buys 30 days. Returns payment_id, the exact pay_amount and wallet_address. Send exactly pay_amount, then call check_payment. Max 3 pending invoices per key.

api_key.description: Optional. Your RiskDataApi key, for MCP hosts that cannot send an Authorization header. If both are present, the Authorization header wins.

usd_amount.description: Top-up amount in USD, 5-500 (default 5); ignored for subscription

tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Checks on-chain whether an invoice from create_topup_invoice has been paid and, if so, credits your key. Safe to call repeatedly (idempotent), at most once every 5 seconds per payment_id (after 30 checks per hour per key, once a minute); if throttled it returns error_code verify_rate_limited with retry_after seconds. Returns verified true/false with a reason.

api_key.description: Optional. Your RiskDataApi key, for MCP hosts that cannot send an Authorization header. If both are present, the Authorization header wins.

tools.name: get_token_risk_history
tools.description: Returns hourly historical data points (safety_score, insider_cluster_count, holder_count, price, liquidity, volume) for a mint over the last N days (max 90). Free and unmetered — no quota, works with or without an API key — pure read from stored history, no live upstream call.

days.description: How many days of history to return (default 30, max 90)
